press_references.value: Saudi: Armah rolls out $65mln deal with Banan Real Estate’s subsidiary

partnership_announcements.description: Armah Sports and Qimam Nashaz Real Estate Development, a subsidiary of Banan Real Estate, announced a $65 million contract for the development and operation of two fitness clubs in Riyadh. Qimam Nashaz will build the clubs, while Armah will lease and operate them for 20 years under the Optimo brand.
